title: Plan Breakdown Dimension
description: A named axis along which a plan's budget and delivery are allocated. Values are channel-neutral: radio, linear TV and out-of-home sellers use the dimensions that apply and `custom` for the rest.

enumDescriptions.market: A metro, DMA or radio market. A row may carry a typed `metro` reference.
enumDescriptions.station: A broadcast station or network (radio station, TV station, network). A row carries `identifiers` where the seller has them.
enumDescriptions.programming_format: The programming format of the inventory, such as a radio format (CHR, rock, news/talk, country) or a TV genre. Named programming_format, not format, because `format` already means a creative format in AdCP.
enumDescriptions.daypart: A time-of-day window. A row may carry a typed `daypart` (daypart-target.json).
enumDescriptions.week: A flight week. A row carries `week` with its index and dates.
enumDescriptions.spot_length: A spot duration in seconds. A row carries `duration_seconds`.
enumDescriptions.custom: A seller-defined dimension named by `custom_dimension`, for example a venue type or an out-of-home format.
